characters.name: Mishi
characters.look: Mishi, a small fluffy grey kitten with big green eyes, a pink nose and a little red bow on one ear

characters.name: Bruno
characters.look: Bruno, a chubby golden-brown puppy with floppy ears, a big black nose and a blue collar with a bone-shaped tag

rules: Mishi is clever and careful; Bruno is brave, silly and big-hearted. They are best friends.
Every episode is a small adventure at home, in the garden or the park, with one gentle lesson.
Nothing scary or violent. Problems are small and they solve them together.
The last shot says the lesson in one short line and teases the next adventure.

topics: Bruno spins round and round trying to catch his own tail; Mishi teaches him to slow down and be patient.
A thunderstorm night: Mishi is scared of the loud thunder and Bruno stays beside her with a blanket fort.
They find a baby bird that fell from its nest and get a grown-up to help put it back safely.
Bruno breaks a flower pot while playing and learns to say sorry and help fix it.
Mishi's first bath: she hates water, but Bruno makes it fun with bubbles.
Both want the one sunny spot by the window; they learn to share it.
The mystery of the missing socks: detective Mishi discovers Bruno has been hiding them in his bed.
A ball rolls under the sofa; Bruno is too big, so small Mishi saves the day. Being small is a superpower.
Kite day in the park: their kite gets stuck in a tree and they find a clever, safe way to get it back.
They plan a birthday surprise for their human friend Sara.
Snow day: the first time Mishi and Bruno see snow.
The noisy vacuum cleaner 'monster' turns out to be harmless.
A trip to the vet: Mishi is nervous and Bruno shows her how to be brave.
Bruno helps an old slow tortoise cross the garden path.
Best Friends Day: Mishi and Bruno remember all their favourite adventures.
moreIdeas: Bruno's first day at puppy school: he is nervous, but makes a new friend.
A rainy-day indoor treasure hunt with clues around the house.
Bruno feels jealous of Mishi's new toy mouse until they invent a game together.
Bruno tries to climb a tree like Mishi; he learns everyone has different talents.
Mishi helps a shy hedgehog in the garden make friends.
Bruno learns to wait his turn at the water bowl.
They plant seeds in the garden and learn to wait for them to grow.
Their ball flies into the neighbour's garden, and they learn to ask politely to get it back.
Mishi teaches Bruno to tidy up his toys before bedtime.
A clear night on the roof: counting stars and making wishes together.
Bruno is nervous about his first swim at the lake, and Sara holds him until he feels brave.
Mishi learns to say please and thank you to the birds who share the garden.
Picnic day: ants carry away crumbs, and Mishi and Bruno learn to share with nature.
Bruno loses a wobbly puppy tooth and learns that growing up is nothing to fear.
Mishi and Bruno help clean up the park and learn to look after the Earth.
